# Aura AI Study Assistant

> Aura is a free, installable web app (PWA) that helps school and college students study. Students can ask questions by text or voice, upload or capture a photo of a problem to get a step-by-step solution, and keep their chat history synced across devices.

## Key facts
- Audience: students in school and college (e.g. Class 9-12, undergraduate).
- Input: typed questions, voice questions (browser speech recognition), photos of problems.
- Output: structured, step-by-step explanations with follow-up question suggestions; answers can be read aloud.
- Accounts: email magic-link or Google sign-in, or guest mode. Chats are private to each user.
- Privacy: users can delete all chat history and search records from Settings at any time.
- Install: open {{SITE_URL}}/ in a mobile browser and choose "Add to Home Screen".
